kind_of_thing.why: A health centre is a clinic staffed by doctors and nurses, so it is a place people build and run.

kind_of_made_thing.quote: A community health center, healthcare center or health center is one of a network of clinics staffed by a group of general practitioners and nurses providing healthcare services to people in a certain area.

what_people_do_there.why: A health centre is a clinic where people go to get medical care and get well.
